findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_market_summary" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: One company's latest nightly StockLens score: the composite score (0 to 100) and its rating word, the domain scores with their grade words, the named signals th…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_to_watchlist, add_to_watchlist_batch, discover_stocks, fetch_analysis_result, get_market_summary, get_portfolio_insights · Private data: add_to_watchlist, add_to_watchlist_batch, get_market_summary · Public sink: add_to_watchlist_batch, fetch_analysis_result, get_portfolio_insights · Destructive: fetch_analysis_result, get_market_summary, initiate_analysis, inspect_reading, remove_from_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_to_watchlist, add_to_watchlist_batch, discover_stocks, fetch_analysis_result, get_market_summary, get_portfolio_insights · Private data: add_to_watchlist, add_to_watchlist_batch, get_market_summary · Public sink: add_to_watchlist_batch, fetch_analysis_result, get_portfolio_insights · Destructive: fetch_analysis_result, get_market_summary, initiate_analysis, inspect_reading, remove_from_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
